purpose: Plan the next OpenClaw lanes for operator review. Hermes recommends sequence, Chief packages bounded next tasks, and Guardian marks protected actions.

hermes_recommendation.summary: Sequence overnight planning around operator review and hygiene first, then client follow-up watches, then hardening work. Nothing should execute while the operator is asleep.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Confirm/discard St. Anne's work-log events
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: The current staged church-sound event is marked SMOKE_OR_TEST_EVENT and NOT_INCLUDED_SMOKE_EVENT. Real billable work needs a separate business confirmation.
recommended_lane_sequence.next_safe_move: Show the operator a confirm/discard plan that preserves smoke evidence and does not include smoke events in rollup.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Build St. Anne's month-end rollup path
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: The rollup must be built from confirmed real events only. The current smoke/test event is explicitly excluded.
recommended_lane_sequence.next_safe_move: List rollup prerequisites and blockers from confirmed events without writing Excel.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Track Capital Hilton proposal response
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: The proposal is sent for client review and must not become finance work until accepted.
recommended_lane_sequence.next_safe_move: Stage a follow-up planning packet only.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Track Capital Hilton Coupa Processing
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: Coupa was recorded as Processing; paid state and ledger truth remain blocked.
recommended_lane_sequence.next_safe_move: Prepare a watch checklist for later operator review.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Excel permission persistence hardening
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: St. Anne's Excel persistence is blocked or unstable, and PDF export needs a receipt-driven path.
recommended_lane_sequence.next_safe_move: Write a bounded hardening plan and safe local probes.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Prepare Telegram/Cassandra dry-run inbox
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: Mission Control instructions route to the package queue; Telegram should enter the same rail later without live credentials.

recommended_lane_sequence.label: Add TTS sanitizer for speaker profiles
recommended_lane_sequence.reason: Operator display copy now has speaker/profile routing, and TTS text needs safe profile-specific preparation.
recommended_lane_sequence.next_safe_move: Map display fields to sanitizer output without connecting TTS.

allowed_actions: inspect local St. Anne's work-log read models
summarize staged, confirmed, and smoke-excluded event states
read the St. Anne's work-log hygiene read model
blocked_actions: include smoke/test events in invoice rollup
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Show that the current church-sound event is smoke/test-only and ask for separate real-world confirmation before any rollup eligibility.

chief_work_packets.goal: Package St. Anne's month-end rollup prerequisites from confirmed real events only, without touching the workbook.
blocked_actions: use smoke/test events as billable invoice truth
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Create a rollup readiness checklist that has zero eligible events until real operator business confirmation exists.

chief_work_packets.goal: Prepare a Capital Hilton proposal follow-up plan that stays in Business Development.
allowed_actions: read operator conversation journal counts for Business Development / Capital Hilton
draft internal follow-up options for operator review
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Stage a follow-up packet that waits for explicit email approval.

chief_work_packets.goal: Package a Capital Hilton Coupa Processing/payment-watch checklist.
allowed_actions: read operator conversation journal counts for Finance / Capital Hilton
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Record that Coupa status is Processing and payment remains unclaimed.

chief_work_packets.goal: Plan Excel permission persistence hardening for workbook/PDF automation.
allowed_actions: catalog known Excel helper failure modes
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Draft a permission-hardening test matrix with no workbook writes.

chief_work_packets.goal: Plan the non-live Telegram/Cassandra adapter into the workflow package queue.
allowed_actions: read Cassandra Telegram intake contract if present
keep Telegram input as dry-run package requests only
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Create or refine local-only tests for Telegram-shaped envelopes.

chief_work_packets.goal: Plan how operator_display fields feed TTS-safe text by speaker profile.
allowed_actions: read voice profile and routing contracts
map visible copy fields to sanitizer input
reuse operator_display summaries from the conversation journal
chief_work_packets.next_safe_move: Keep TTS as local text preparation until a separate approval creates a live provider gate.

guardian_gates.reason: Email send is an external action and must remain blocked until a specific explicit send approval exists.
Coupa submission requires operator-present login/MFA, final Submit confirmation, and receipt preservation.
Ledger posting is finance truth and is not granted by planning, proposal, invoice, or operator-assist receipts.
Paid state must only change from explicit payment evidence and is never inferred from send, submit, or proposal status.
Workbook mutation requires staged patch approval and stable workbook permissions.
PDF export must be artifact-backed with page count, hash, and operator review before downstream use.
Browser, Gmail, Coupa, Telegram, and TTS providers are not part of this planning-only board.
Chief, Hermes, Guardian, Cassandra, and legacy loop scripts must not be launched by this workboard.
Remote git push is outside this task and remains blocked.
